The matching source is a YouTube upload of the complete 1997 Beat Factory compilation posted by the channel Potlood; its description identifies the actual recording artists track by track, including Infinite, Grimmy Grimmy feat. Shakari Nite, Down To Erf, Tara Chase, Madlocks, Asia, Michie Mee, Arsenal a.k.a. Verbal Soldier, Marvel, Sic Sense, St8ofmind, Furee, M.A.D., Motion, Illegal Justice and Crooks Of Da Round Table.
